source_clause: ICE15.) Always show 'Driver' or 'Passenger'. Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration (see Climate section). Active state text color is white. Inactive state text color is gray. When entering the controls screen the current state of the buttons will be displayed.
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.16（ICE15）以五句定出 ICS controls screen 上座椅類控制之標示與狀態呈現，五個 037 leaf 逐句對應，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1），本輪產四條、`-02` 停下（見刻意略過）。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取正向值（`PC_EMEA`）；依 **R-C34**，**第十三軸不補** —— C15 之例外所移除者為 `HVAC menu bar icons`／`HVAC screens`／`HVAC pop ups`，而本節之可觀察量為**座椅控制之 controls screen**，不屬該三者，補之即為過嚴之排除（35 §1 之形態）；第九軸全數補（controls screen 屬 head unit 之 comfort section）；第十二軸不補（ch16 無 tab 條文）。為什麼這樣切：`-03` 與 `-04` 為 active／inactive 兩個互補狀態，各自可獨立失效（白色對而灰色錯），合併後無法定位；`-05` 之驗證對象為**進入畫面時**之狀態呈現，其失效形態（進入後才更新）與前二者無關。刻意略過：**`-02` 停下不產列** —— 「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration (**see Climate section**)」之委派對象為本 spec 之另一節而非外部文件（故非 `[BLOCKED-SPEC]`），其性質又確為介面可觀察（故非 `[BLOCKED-NON-HMI]`），而所缺者為「哪一種 system configuration 對應哪一個 off icon」之對照表，形態同 `DATA_REQUESTS` #17；新 marker 不得於生成當下自創（**R-C26**／profile §5.4 末），故回報待裁並登 **DR #32**；**44 §2 之 R-C39 立了第四類 `[COVERED-BY]` 後已逐項核對五條件**：第一項成立（未指名外部文件）、**第二項不成立**（「Climate section」未指名節次，實測全 129 節僅 16.16 自身含 `off icon`，座椅類候選 `12.3`／`14.16.1` 兩組皆未生成）、第三項因無對象 TC 而無法執行、第四項成立（餘留為「depend on system configuration」，無可判之期望值），依 R-C39 明文「第二項未滿足時不得先標 `[COVERED-BY]`，該 leaf 標 `deferred`」，**維持停下**。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: ICS controls screen 之座椅類控制（標示與 active／inactive 呈現）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補（controls screen 屬 head unit 之 comfort section）
interface_axis_review.axis_13: **不暴露 → 不補** —— C15 之例外所移除者為 `HVAC menu bar icons`／`HVAC screens`／`HVAC pop ups`，而本節之可觀察量為**座椅控制之 controls screen**，不屬該三者；補之即為過嚴之排除（35 §1 形態）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 取正向軸值 PC，出處 16.2

tcs.tc_title: Driver and Passenger labels are always shown
tcs.test_item:
ICE15.) Always show 'Driver' or 'Passenger'.

(read the labels on the seat controls -> Each seat control shows a "Driver" or "Passenger" label)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the controls screen
2. Read the labels on the seat controls
tcs.expected_result:
1. The controls screen is displayed
2. Each seat control shows a "Driver" or "Passenger" label
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: The system shall always show "Driver" or "Passenger"

tcs.tc_title: Entering the controls screen shows the current button states
tcs.test_item:
When entering the controls screen the current state of the buttons will be displayed.

(enter the controls screen -> The controls screen shows one seat control active and the other inactive)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn one seat control on and another seat control off, then leave the controls screen
2. Enter the controls screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The controls screen is no longer displayed
2. The controls screen shows one seat control active and the other inactive
tcs.test_item_authored: When entering the controls screen the current state of the buttons shall be displayed
